other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies feature transformations (such as TF-IDF fitting, median imputation, frequency encoding, and group aggregations) to the entire training dataset before splitting it into cross-validation folds. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, making the out-of-fold validation scores overly optimistic and unreliable.

summary: The agent has produced a robust modeling pipeline with extensive feature engineering, multiple strong model types, and optimized ensembling. However, there is a notable issue with cross-validation leakage: several statistics and text transformations are computed globally across the entire training set before the CV loops, which compromises the reliability of the out-of-fold validation scores.
